method: Manual spot-check of all 5 prompts in raw outputs file (environment/coherence-probes/2026-05-23-Llama-PLLuM-70B-instruct-2512-awq-coherence-raw.txt). All 5 responses confirmed as coherent Polish.
auto_flag_failure_root_cause: n-gram repetition heuristic produces false positives on short correct answers. Worked example: prompt 1 ('Jaka jest stolica Polski?') → response 'Stolicą Polski jest Warszawa.' (4 words). top_ngram_share = 0.5 at word_count = 4 triggers coherent=false despite a perfectly correct answer; pairwise n-gram overlap is trivially high on any short sentence.

evidence.notes: Manual spot-check examples: 'fakt' = correct stolica; 'streszczenie' = accurate botanika definition (uses synonym fitologia); 'definicja' = correct fotosynteza; 'polecenie' = alphabetic ordering of pory roku correct; 'porownanie' = sensible rower/samochód contrast (siła mięśni vs zmechanizowany).

methodology_anchor: METHODOLOGY §8 — auto-flags are mechanical; raw outputs are retained for human spot-check. Human verdict is part of the Gate 2 boundary by design.
